paite: Mi kuate hiam Judia gam a kipan in ahong suk ua unaute kiang ah, "Mosi Dan bang a zek na sum kei uleh hotdam na hi thei kei ding uh," chi in ahong gen uhi.
heading: Zentel Gingtute Leh Mosi Dan
english: Some men came down from Judea and taught the brothers, “Unless you are circumcised after the custom of Moses, you can’t be saved.”

paite: Huchi in Paul leh Barnabas in amaute kalh in nakpitak a kisel a akilan ziak un, huai thubuai tungtang a Jerusalem a sawltakliante leh upate va mu ding in Paul leh Barnabas, leh alak ua kuate hiam asep uhi.
english: Therefore when Paul and Barnabas had no small discord and discussion with them, they appointed Paul, Barnabas, and some others of them to go up to Jerusalem to the apostles and elders about this question.

paite: Huchi in saptuamte'n ava kha ua, amau Zentelte hong kikhekdan thu gen zel in, Phoinisia gam leh Samaria gam atawnsuakta uh; huchi in unaute tengteng akipaksak mahmah uhi.
english: They, being sent on their way by the assembly, passed through both Phoenicia and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles. They caused great joy to all the brothers.

paite: Jerusalem atuntouh un saptuam pawlte, sawltakte, upate'n ana kipahpih ua; Pathian in amau zang a athilhihte apuangkhe zelzel uhi.
english: When they had come to Jerusalem, they were received by the assembly and the apostles and the elders, and they reported everything that God had done with them.

paite: Himahleh Pharisai pawl a mi gingta kuate hiam akisa ua, "Zentelte zeksum ding leh Mosi Dan azuih chiat ding uh ahi," achi uhi.
english: But some of the sect of the Pharisees who believed rose up, saying, “It is necessary to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.”

paite: Huan sawltakliante leh upate, huai thu ngaihtuah ding in akikhawm uhi.
heading: Jerusalem A Saptuam Khawmpi
english: The apostles and the elders were gathered together to see about this matter.

paite: Nakpi a akisel nung un Peter adingtou a, akiang uah, "Mite leh unaute aw, Zentelte'n keimah kam a tanchinhoih thu za a gingta ding a, Pathian in nidanglai a na lak ua kipan ahon sehdan na thei uhi.
english: When there had been much discussion, Peter rose up and said to them, “Brothers, you know that a good while ago God made a choice among you that by my mouth the nations should hear the word of the Good News and believe.

paite: Lungsim theipa Pathian in eite hon piak bang mah in Kha Siangthou akiang ua pe sam in atung uah akipak chih atheisak hi.
english: God, who knows the heart, testified about them, giving them the Holy Spirit, just like he did to us.

paite: Huan eite leh amau khentuam nei lou in ginna in alungsim uh ahihsiangthou hi.
english: He made no distinction between us and them, cleansing their hearts by faith.

paite: Huchi in i pipute leh eite'n i zuih zoh louhsa hakkol, tu'n ah nungzuite tung a ngak tum a bangziak a Pathian kalh na hi ua?
english: Now therefore why do you tempt God, that you should put a yoke on the neck of the disciples which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?

paite: Amau gintak bang mah in eite'n leng Toupa Jesu hehpihna ziak a hotdam ding hi in i kigingta ngal ua,” achi hi.
english: But we believe that we are saved through the grace of the Lord Jesus, just as they are.”

paite: Barnabas leh Paul in, amaute zang a Pathian in Zentelte lak a chiamtehna leh thillamdang ahih thu agen lai un mipite'n ngaikhia in adai sipsip uhi.
english: All the multitude kept silence, and they listened to Barnabas and Paul reporting what signs and wonders God had done among the nations through them.

paite: Huchi a mipite adaih sipsip zoh un Jakob in adawng a, “Unaute aw, ka thu ngaikhia un, chi in agen sam hi.
english: After they were silent, James answered, “Brothers, listen to me.

paite: Simeon in, Pathian in amah min pu ding leh alak ua kipan mite lakhe ding in Zentelte aveh tungthu agenta hi.
english: Simeon has reported how God first visited the nations to take out of them a people for his name.

paite: Huai thu leh zawlneite thu, gelh a omsa toh akituak hi.
english: This agrees with the words of the prophets. As it is written,

paite: Huai khit chiang in ka kik nawn ding a, David biakbuk chimsia ka bawl nawn ding a, asiatna lai ka puah ding a, ka tungding nawn ding.
english: ‘After these things I will return. I will again build the tabernacle of David, which has fallen. I will again build its ruins. I will set it up

paite: Midang akhosuaksunte leh ka min pu Zentelte ka min kikoppihte'n, Toupa azonna ding un huai thilte tengteng ahihta hi," chi in.
english: that the rest of men may seek after the Lord: all the Gentiles who are called by my name, says the Lord, who does all these things.’

paite: "Khovel siamchil a kipan hiai thu theisakpa Toupa'n achi," chih gelh ahi.
english: “All of God’s works are known to him from eternity.

paite: "Huaiziak in Zentelte lak a Pathian lam ngate hihgim kei ni chih ka thusawm ahi.
english: Therefore my judgment is that we don’t trouble those from among the Gentiles who turn to God,

paite: Milim biakna in abuahsak thilsiang lou, kingaihna nin, sa heklup leh sisan nek atawpsanna ding un akiang uah laigelh zaw lehang, ka chi pen hi.
english: but that we write to them that they abstain from the pollution of idols, from sexual immorality, from what is strangled, and from blood.

paite: Mosi Dan lah nidanglai a kipan kho teng ah athu tangkoupih ahih ban ah sinagog peuh ah Sabbath niteng in athu sim ahi,” achi hi.
english: For Moses from generations of old has in every city those who preach him, being read in the synagogues every Sabbath.”

paite: Huan sawltakte, upate, saptuam tengteng toh, apawl ua mitel, Paul leh Barnabas kiang ah Antiok a hohsak hoih asa ua; atelte uh min Judas, Barnabas achih uh leh Silas ahi ua, huai mite unaute lak a heutu deuhte ahi uhi.
heading: Jerusalem Khawmpi Thutanna
english: Then it seemed good to the apostles and the elders, with the whole assembly, to choose men out of their company, and send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas: Judas called Barsabbas, and Silas, chief men among the brothers.

paite: Hichibang in agelh ua, akhut uah akhak uh: "Sawltakte leh unaute lak a upate'n Antiok khua, Siria gam leh Silisia gam a Zentel unaute chibai abuk uhi.
english: They wrote these things by their hand: “The apostles, the elders, and the brothers, to the brothers who are of the Gentiles in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia: greetings.

paite: Ka pawl lak ua mi kuate hiam in noute kiang a thu gen in, zeksum ding leh Mosi Dan zui ding in ahon hihbuai ua, na lungsim uh ahon mangbangsak uh chih ka za ua, amaute hiai thu gen ding in ka sawl kei uhi.
english: Because we have heard that some who went out from us have troubled you with words, unsettling your souls, saying, ‘You must be circumcised and keep the law,’ to whom we gave no commandment;

paite: Huaiziak in thukhat sat a ka kikhop un, ka deihtak uh Barnabas leh Paul,
english: it seemed good to us, having come to one accord, to choose out men and send them to you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,

paite: Toupa Jesu Khrist min ziak a sih khawk saloute toh, mitelte na kiang ua hon sawl hoih ka sa uhi.
english: men who have risked their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: Huchi in Judas leh Silas ka hon sawl uhi, amau leng hiai thu mah kam in ahon hilh ding uhi.
english: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who themselves will also tell you the same things by word of mouth.

paite: Hiai thu poimohte ka gelhte uh chih louh ngal Kha Siangthou leh koute'n puakgik tuan na tung uah bangmah nga kei le ung hoih ka sa uhi.
english: For it seemed good to the Holy Spirit, and to us, to lay no greater burden on you than these necessary things:

paite: Milim biakna sa nek, sa sisan nek leh kingaih tawpsan le uchin ka chi uhi; hiaite na tawp uleh nou a ding in ahoih ding hi. Damtak in om un,” chi in.
english: that you abstain from things sacrificed to idols, from blood, from things strangled, and from sexual immorality, from which if you keep yourselves, it will be well with you. Farewell.”

paite: Huchi in asawl un akuan ua, Antiok khua atungsuk ua; mipi asamkhawm ua, lai apia uhi.
heading: Zentel Gingtute Kiang A Laikhak
english: So, when they were sent off, they came to Antioch. Having gathered the multitude together, they delivered the letter.

paite: Huan asim khit un lungmuanna thu ziak in akipak mahmahta uhi.
english: When they had read it, they rejoiced over the encouragement.

paite: Judas leh Silas in, zawlnei leng ahi ua, thu tampi in unaute akhamuan ua, ahihkip uhi.
english: Judas and Silas, also being prophets themselves, encouraged the brothers with many words and strengthened them.

paite: Huan huai a sawt khop a-om nung un amau sawltakte kiang apai nawn ding in, unaute'n khamuangtak in apawtsak nawnta uhi.
english: After they had spent some time there, they were dismissed in peace from the brothers to the apostles.

paite: Bang teng hileh Silas in bel akiang ua om takdih hoih asa hi.
Paul leh Barnabas bel midang tampite toh Antiok ah Toupa thuhilh leh gen in a-om nilouh uhi.
english: But Paul and Barnabas stayed in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.

paite: Huan ni bangzah hiam nung in Paul in Barnabas kiang ah, "Kho teng a Toupa thu i genna peuh a unau omte va veh nawn in, a-omdan uh va en lehang," achi hi.
heading: Paul Leh Barnabas Kikhenna
english: After some days Paul said to Barnabas, “Let’s return now and visit our brothers in every city in which we proclaimed the word of the Lord, to see how they are doing.”

paite: Barnabas in Johan, Marka achih uh, akiang ua tonpih atum hi.
english: Barnabas planned to take John, who was called Mark, with them also.

paite: Himahleh Paul in bel, ama'n Pamphilia gam a amaute kiksan a, nasepna a akiang ua ahoh louh ziak in tonpih hoih asa kei hi.
english: But Paul didn’t think that it was a good idea to take with them someone who had withdrawn from them in Pamphylia, and didn’t go with them to do the work.

paite: Huchi in nakpi in akiselta ua, huan akikhen ua Barnabas in Marka atonpih a, Kupra tuikulh lam ah long in apaita hi.
english: Then the contention grew so sharp that they separated from each other. Barnabas took Mark with him and sailed away to Cyprus,

paite: Paul in Silas atel a, unaute'n Toupa hehpihna akepsak nung un apaikheta uhi.
english: but Paul chose Silas and went out, being commended by the brothers to the grace of God.

paite: Huan saptuam pawlte hihkip zel in Siria leh Silisia gam atawnsuak uhi.
english: He went through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the assemblies.
